customer_james: Hey team — hitting parse failures with JSON mode on our production route. Client throws a hard error: "invalid JSON" when parsing items array. Example response we got from the API:

customer_james: ```json
{"orderId":"ord_123","items":[{"id":"sku_1","qty":1},{"id":"sku_2","qty":2,"extraMeta":{"warehouse":"A1"}}],"customer":{"name":"Jane"}}
```

customer_james: Our schema requires items[].price (number) and items[].skuCode (string). The model omitted price for the first item and added an unexpected nested key extraMeta on the second item. The client library fails early on missing required fields and we end up retrying requests.

sara_support: Sorry for the trouble — can you share the request payload you sent (headers + body) and which model + json_schema flags you used? Also which SDK/version?

customer_james: Using curl to the hosted API, model: "redwood-gpt-instruct-1" (v2025-09-01). We passed a JSON schema via the json_schema param (see snippet):

customer_james: ```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"orderId":{"type":"string"},"items":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string"},"qty":{"type":"integer"},"price":{"type":"number"},"skuCode":{"type":"string"}},"required":["id","price","skuCode"]}},"customer":{"type":"object"}},"required":["orderId","items"]}
```

sara_support: Got it. Two things we'll check: 1) whether the model output was truncated/stream cut causing the first item to drop price, 2) whether the JSON-mode validator rejected due to extraMeta being unrecognized (strict mode). As a temporary mitigation you can enable the relax_json_schema option or set temperature=0 and max_tokens a bit higher to reduce partial/creative outputs.

eng_ben: Looks like schema drift + partial object generation. I'll try to repro locally. Quick repro command I used in a sandbox — sets temperature=0 and explicit stop tokens to avoid truncation:

eng_ben: ```bash
curl -s https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"redwood-gpt-instruct-1","input":"Generate order JSON","json_schema":<schema blob>,"temperature":0,"max_tokens":800}'
```

eng_ben: Reproduced: model produced items with missing price for item 0 when the sample prompt included an illustrative example with one item omitting price. Prompt priming matters. We'll push a fix to the JSON-mode post-processor to return a structured validation error (which includes which item index failed) instead of passing raw invalid JSON to the client.

ml_eva: Additional suggestions: 1) Add an examples field in the schema prompt so the model sees required fields in every example, 2) Use the server-side fill defaults feature (we can populate missing numeric fields with null or 0 depending on your tolerance), 3) Treat unknown extra keys like extraMeta as allowed (additionalProperties: true) if you expect variant downstream metadata.

customer_james: Also seeing retry storms — our service retried on parse error and billing jumped ~2x last hour. Can billing flag this while we patch?

billing_aly: @sara_support @eng_ben I can put a temporary billing credit hold for that customer ID  — please send me the account ID and request IDs from the failing calls.

infra_bot: deploy-bot: New job queued (#3245) by eng_ben — testing JSON-mode post-processor patch in canary.

eng_ben: I'll run the canary with enhanced validation that returns a clear status code 422 + body {"validation_errors":[{"path":"items[0].price","reason":"missing required"}] }. That should stop clients from blindly retrying.

customer_james: Thanks — one more thing: our client assumes items preserve submission order; we observed items reordered in some responses which breaks downstream matching. Any guidance?

ml_eva: Model may reorder when using natural language list generation. Use an explicit JSON array in prompt examples and set the server parameter preserve_array_order=true on the route (beta) — that enforces array serialization order. We'll add docs.

sara_support: Action items: eng_ben to push canary for validation error upgrade; ml_eva to update docs and add best-practice prompt snippets; billing_aly to request account details for credit; customer_james to share account/request-ids and the original curl request body if possible. We'll follow up in this thread. :thumbsup:
